question: Which beloved of Śambhu grants constant protection everywhere?
premises: The seer invokes protection always and everywhere
The goddess addressed is beloved of Śambhu
Her protection is sought without spatial limit
inference: The goddess beloved of Śambhu is invoked to protect always and everywhere.
uncertainties: The role of ṛṣiḥ as subject or invoker is slightly ambiguous.
plain_english: May the seer protect; O goddess, beloved of Śambhu, may you always protect everywhere.
